messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Adolescents and higher-weight children (aged 7 and older): Treatment starts at 10 mg/day, increasing to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks.
Additional dose increases may be considered after several more weeks if insufficient clinical improvement is observed.
The recommended dose range is 20 mg to 60 mg per day.
Lower-weight children: Treatment starts at 10 mg/day with dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement.
The recommended dose range is 20 mg to 30 mg per day.
Experience with daily doses greater than 20 mg is very minimal.
Bulimia Nervosa:
Adult dose: The recommended dose is 60 mg once daily in the morning.
Your doctor may gradually increase your dose to this level over several days.
Clinical trials showed that the 60 mg dose was effective.
The 60 mg dose was effective in reducing binge-eating and purging behaviors.
Panic Disorder:
Adult dose: Treatment starts at 10 mg/day, increasing to 20 mg/day after one week.
Your doctor may adjust the dose after several weeks if needed.
Clinical trials used a dose range of 10 mg/day to 60 mg/day.
Triplet: ["Fluoxetine", "has clinical trial result", "60 mg dose was effective in reducing binge-eating and purging behaviors for bulimia nervosa"]

The relation 'has clinical trial result' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug demonstrated the clinical outcome or effect specified by the object entity in clinical trials.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has benefit': The subject drug has the benefit or therapeutic effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
